decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is cheap to maintain as a delivery option, but it overlaps with umbrella line D, so it carries some consolidation risk; its value is not yet disproven, so keeping the option remains the cheaper choice.
The seventy-two-hour service is operationally demanding and could be folded into the express umbrella, but there is no clear evidence that it lacks value, so the option stays open for now.
This European-certified exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular fire-door system and has largely resolved its uncertainty in a favorable direction, which justifies further commitment.
The multi-model express line with its own page is the strategic umbrella for fast delivery and remains a valuable platform worth investing in further.
The digital ordering and services platform has low marginal cost and high upside, and it fits the firm's service-oriented direction toward trade partners.
The fire and smoke protection door sits close to the certified core offer, faces steady compliance-driven demand, and costs little to keep.
